description: This file defines a singleton object 'ShopRepository' that provides in-memory data management for products, categories, and cart state. It includes methods for retrieving products and categories, managing cart contents, and computing totals, serving as a mock repository in an online shopping platform.

classes.name: ShopRepository.CartItem
classes.description: Data class representing an item in the shopping cart, including product details and quantity, with methods to calculate line total and formatted total.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns the list of predefined product categories.

methods.name: getAllProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of predefined products.

methods.name: findProductById
methods.description: Finds and returns a product by its ID or null if not found.

methods.name: getCategoryName
methods.description: Returns the name of a category given its ID, or 'Unknown' if not found.

methods.name: cartLiveData
methods.description: Provides a LiveData object to observe changes in the cart state.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the cart, updating the cart state.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity for a product in the cart, removing it if quantity is zero or less.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: cartItems
methods.description: Returns a list of CartItem objects representing items currently in the cart.

methods.name: cartTotalCents
methods.description: Calculates the total cost of items in the cart in cents.
